name: shopitup
description: Find and buy secondhand clothing from independent stores on ShopItUp, in your size, with checkout on shopitup.ca.

interface.longDescription: Search items from independent secondhand clothing stores on ShopItUp by what you want, your size, price and condition. Get the details of an item and the store that sells it, see the total with shipping and tax to your Canadian address, and get a link to the store's ShopItUp checkout to review and pay. Sign in to use your saved sizes and shipping address and to see your orders. Payment always happens on ShopItUp's checkout page; the assistant never sees or charges your card.
defaultPrompt: Find a wool coat in my size under $80
Show me vintage denim jackets in size M
What would this cost shipped to my address?
